description: This file contains utility functions for nl80211, including conversions between nl80211 bandwidth and frequency band enums and internal representations, as well as associated data tables.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_bwNlToSwl
methods.description: Converts NL80211 bandwidth ID to internal swl bandwidth enum.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_bwSwlToNl
methods.description: Converts internal swl bandwidth enum to NL80211 bandwidth ID.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_bwNlToVal
methods.description: Converts NL80211 bandwidth ID to bandwidth value in MHz.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_bwValToNl
methods.description: Converts bandwidth value in MHz to NL80211 bandwidth ID.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_freqBandSwlToNl
methods.description: Converts swl frequency band enum to NL80211 band ID.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_freqBandNlToSwl
methods.description: Converts NL80211 band ID to swl frequency band enum.
